name: h8man/NavMeshPlus
description: A Unity extension enabling 2D navigation mesh pathfinding with automatic generation from tilemap, sprite, and 2D collider scene geometry for top-down games.
score_rationale: 2.2k stars, MIT, fills a critical gap in Unity 2D game development where built-in NavMesh only supports 3D.
summary: Unity 2D navmesh generation and pathfinding for top-down games
